title: Setting Sail

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly (labels can be read aloud)

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Setting sail takes many hands, and everything must happen in the right order.

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Here are the steps on cards. Can you put them in order, from first to last?

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Put the steps in order: what do we do first?
steps.hint: What must happen before we can raise the anchor?

feedback.out_of_order: Some cards came back. What must come first?
feedback.all_good: Load, wave, raise, hoist, and away! That's how a ship sets sail.

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: If you forget the stores, you'll be hungry. If you forget the anchor, you won't go anywhere at all! Order matters at sea.

journal_line: I put the steps for setting sail in order with Captain Mara.
